newsitem.title: PERU: Peru central bank to reduce deposit interest rate.
newsitem.headline: Peru central bank to reduce deposit interest rate.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said it will reduce by one percentage point from September 16 the interest it pays on local banks' foreign currency deposits.
"Up to September 15, the remuneration will be based on the three-month LIBOR rate, and from the 16th it will be the three- month LIBOR rate minus one percentage point," a Central Bank source said.
Analysts said the measure was probably intended by the government to reduce the level of dollar deposits and encourage saving in the local sol currency.
Banking sources said the move might prompt a reduction in private banks' interest rates for dollar currency deposit accounts.
